h1: Gallery Lake View Hotel — Lakeside on Bueng Kaen Nakhon, Lake Views and a Balcony in Every Room in Central Khon Kaen
intro: If you want to wake up, open your balcony door to a wide stretch of water, then walk across the road to run or cycle around the lake — Gallery Lake View Hotel is the name people staying in Khon Kaen bring up most when the talk turns to a lakeside location · the hotel sits right on the road that loops Bueng Kaen Nakhon, the city's central lake that doubles as its green lung and exercise spot · the standout is the art-gallery styling, with a different art theme on each floor, plus rooms that are roomy, clean, and come with a private balcony in every room, some with a full view of the lake · there is free parking and bikes to rent · from about THB 800/night · scored 8.9 from 100 reviews on Trip.com and 4.3 out of 5 on Tripadvisor

body.html: Who Gallery Lake View suits — the big picture — to put it as simply as possible, Gallery Lake View Hotel is a place for people who want to stay by the water in central Khon Kaen without driving all the way out to a resort beyond the city · it is not a tall, upscale tower in the business district, and it is not a tiny boutique selling private quiet · it is a mid-sized hotel that sits right on the road around Bueng Kaen Nakhon, the central lake locals use for running, cycling, and unwinding in the evening · what sets it apart from other hotels in town is the art-gallery decorating concept, with a different East-meets-West art theme on each floor, which makes it feel more like staying in a small gallery than an ordinary hotel · real reviews line up on who fits here: couples after a water view, families who drive in and need parking, exercise lovers who want to wake up and run around the lake, and travellers who come to Khon Kaen on a modest budget but want a nicer setting than the usual in-town hotel · another group that says it left happy is people here on errands or visiting relatives who want a quiet spot by the water, away from busy main roads · you could say it is a hotel that plays on "a water view and lakeside atmosphere at a price you can reach" — a mix you do not find often in the city of Khon Kaen

Location and getting around — this is Gallery Lake View's number-one selling point, no question · the hotel sits on the road around Bueng Kaen Nakhon on the Nai Mueang side, across from the Bueng Kaen Nakhon lakeside park, which has a running track and a cycling track that loop the lake for about 3 kilometres · just walk across the road and you are at the water — go for a morning run, an evening ride, or sit and watch the sunset over the lake, all right away · around the lake there are also restaurants, cafes, and lakeside eateries within walking distance · the longer trips are still convenient: it is about a 10 min drive to Central Plaza Khon Kaen and Khon Kaen University, and close to the City Pillar Shrine and the Bueng Tao Ngow Ma Shrine · Khon Kaen Airport (KKC) is about 11 kilometres away, or roughly a 15-20 min drive · the point reviews keep agreeing on is that, while it counts as being in town, the location leans toward the edge of the city by the lake — it is not next to the shopping district or Khao Niao Road, the eating-and-drinking strip, so reaching the centre or a mall means a drive · people who do not bring their own car may have to rely mainly on Grab or tuk-tuks, which at certain times are slower to hail than in the central area, so it suits people who drive in more

"Great location, right by the lake — you can walk across the road and stroll around it, with restaurants and cafes nearby within walking distance. The room was wider than I expected, clean, the bed comfortable, and plenty of parking so no worries."

Room types and decor — Gallery Lake View has rooms at several levels, starting with the Superior Room, the entry room but wider than the standard rooms at similarly priced hotels in town · stepping up to the Deluxe Room and a Triple for three, which suits families or groups of friends · and the largest is the Lake View Suite, which leans on the lake view and a bigger seating area · what makes this hotel memorable is the art-gallery decorating concept, with a different art theme on each floor blending Eastern and Western touches, with artwork and decor along the corridors and in the rooms, so the feel never gets stale · every room has a private balcony, a point reviews praise a lot, because you can step out for some air, and some rooms look out over Bueng Kaen Nakhon in full · rooms have air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a small fridge, free drinking water, blackout curtains, and an en-suite bathroom with a water heater · many reviews agree that the rooms are very clean, roomy, the beds comfortable, and the air conditioning cools well · some who booked a large-bed room say they got two singles pushed together into a large bed, which made for a very comfortable night · the thing to watch from the moment you book is that not every room has a lake view, even though the hotel's name says Lake View — if you want a water view you have to ask for a lake-side room or book a room type that specifies a lake view directly

Facilities, and the pool question — let us be straight from the start: this hotel has no swimming pool · the draw here is the lakeside location and the artistic atmosphere, not destination-resort facilities, so if you are travelling with kids who want a pool to splash in, understand this before booking · what makes up for it nicely is the exercise space around the lake, just across the road — run, walk, or cycle the 3-kilometre loop, and the hotel offers bike rental so you can ride around the lake easily · other facilities include free on-site parking, which is roomy and a point drivers praise as reassuring, a lift, a 24-hour front desk, housekeeping, laundry service, luggage storage, a banquet room, and airport transfer (for a fee) · there is free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel · there are also balconies and a terrace to sit and take in the view · overall the facilities lean toward simple and genuinely usable, suited to an overnight or a couple of nights while exploring Khon Kaen rather than a destination where you spend the whole day inside the hotel

Food and dining — the hotel's main restaurant is the Gallery Restaurant, serving mostly Thai food, open for lunch and dinner, with room service at certain times · breakfast is a buffet served 7:00-10:00 AM, with both Asian and Western dishes to choose from · reviews on breakfast are fairly split — many praise it as having a decent range and acceptable taste for what you pay, but some say the choices are not very varied and the quality depends on timing, with some items running out or not topped up in time if you come down late · some reviews also mention the breakfast price or extra service charges feeling a touch high for a hotel of this level, so check clearly whether the room rate you book includes breakfast · a big help is the lakeside location, because around Bueng Kaen Nakhon there are plenty of restaurants and cafes within walking or driving distance, so many people choose to eat out rather than have every meal at the hotel, which is part of the charm of staying by the water in this area · overall, food at Gallery Lake View is a passable add-on, not a reason to come and eat at the hotel as your main plan

Service — service is another point that draws steady praise in real reviews · staff are praised as friendly, smiling, helpful, and good at suggesting things to see and places to eat around the lake · the service score on Trip.com sits at around 9.0, which is high for accommodation at this price · there is a 24-hour front desk, which puts people arriving late or checking in off-hours more at ease · but to be straight, some reviews mention noise, both from housekeeping cleaning in the morning and from guests in neighbouring rooms at times, plus the Wi-Fi system needing a fresh log-in every time you use it, which is a minor annoyance · overall, service is still a strong point and one reason the hotel's overall score stays in good shape

Voices from real reviews (praise and gripes) — pulled together from Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda, and Tripadvisor, and the picture that emerges is fairly consistent · on the praise side: the lakeside location on Bueng Kaen Nakhon where you can cross the road and exercise right away, rooms that are roomy and clean beyond the price, comfortable beds, air conditioning that cools well, a balcony in every room with some lovely lake views, friendly and helpful staff, roomy free parking, and the arty decor that never gets stale · on the watch-out side: the thing brought up most is the edge-of-town location — without your own car it feels far from the shopping district and the centre · next is that not every room has a lake view, even with the name Lake View; the building and some of the decor are starting to look dated with age; breakfast choices are limited and quality depends on timing; the Wi-Fi needs repeated log-ins; there is noise from housekeeping or neighbouring rooms at times; and the water pressure, which some reviews grumble is not as strong as it should be · most of these gripes are things you can manage by choosing your room and setting expectations right, rather than being big problems

"Clean, roomy room, and the balcony has a lovely view of the lake in the morning · the only downside is it is a bit far from the city — without a car you have to call a Grab, and the Wi-Fi has to be logged in every time, which is a little annoying. But overall great value."

Price and value — the starting rate for a Superior room is about THB 800/night at normal prices (some promotions drop to around THB 750), and can climb to roughly THB 1,200-1,500 in high season or during city events · Deluxe and Triple rooms fall in the range of about THB 1,000-1,400 depending on size and timing, while the Lake View Suite goes higher than that · compared with similarly priced hotels in Khon Kaen, most of which are towers in the commercial district, Gallery Lake View feels very good value when it comes to atmosphere, because you get a lakeside location, roomy rooms, a balcony, and free parking at a price no different from the usual in-town hotel · what makes it even better value is the exercise space around the lake just across the road, which amounts to a large park as a free facility · if you plan to drive in and want a lakeside atmosphere on a budget of around a thousand-plus, every baht you spend on this location comes back in full — but if you weigh being close to malls and the eating-and-drinking strip more heavily, you may have to weigh a central-city hotel instead

Good to know before booking — a few things help the stay go more smoothly · one, if you want a lake view you have to ask for a lake-side room or book a room type that specifies a lake view from the moment you book, because not every room sees the water · two, if you are not driving in, have a transport plan ready, because the location leans toward the edge of town and hailing a ride at certain times is slower than in the centre — driving in or renting a car is more convenient · three, check clearly whether the room rate you book includes breakfast, as reviews mention breakfast and extra service charges feeling high · four, if you are sensitive to noise, ask for a room away from the main corridor or the lift to cut down on noise from housekeeping and other guests in the morning · five, make the most of the lakeside location by waking up early to run or cycle around the lake before starting your day of sightseeing, and going for a lakeside stroll to watch the sunset in the evening · six, during Khon Kaen's big events like the Silk Fair and festivals around Bueng Kaen Nakhon, rooms fill up fast and prices climb, so book ahead and pick free cancellation if your plans are not set

The verdict — from all the real reviews, Gallery Lake View Hotel is the best fit for people who want to stay by Bueng Kaen Nakhon on an affordable budget, with roomy rooms, a balcony, and an artistic atmosphere that never gets stale · the lakeside location where you can cross the road and exercise around the lake right away, free parking, and friendly service make it good value for atmosphere — hard to match at the same price in the city · if you are after the convenience of being next to a mall and the eating-and-drinking strip in the centre, or you want a pool and full resort-style facilities, this may not be the answer, and you should look at a central-city hotel or one with a pool instead · but for a Khon Kaen trip where you want a lakeside atmosphere, roomy rooms for the price, and a calm that is hard to find in town — Gallery Lake View answers that need well, especially if you drive in and love waking up to a water view and cool air from your room's balcony

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Gallery Lake View Hotel Khon Kaen

faq.q: Where is Gallery Lake View Hotel · what is nearby?
faq.a: It sits on the Bueng Kaen Nakhon loop road in Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, right on Bueng Kaen Nakhon in the city centre · across from the park and the 3 km running-cycling track around the lake, just walk across the road · about a 10 min drive to Central Plaza Khon Kaen and Khon Kaen University · close to the Bueng Tao Ngow Ma Shrine · Khon Kaen Airport is about a 15-20 min drive

faq.q: What is the starting price at Gallery Lake View Hotel · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 800/night for a Superior room at normal rates (some promotions drop to around THB 750) · there is a Deluxe Room at about THB 1,100 · a Deluxe Triple for 3 people at about THB 1,400 · and a Lake View Suite that leans on the lake view · prices during city events and high season climb fast, so compare several platforms before booking

faq.q: Does every room at Gallery Lake View have a lake view?
faq.a: Not every room has a lake view, even though the hotel's name says Lake View · if you want a water view you should ask for a lake-side room or book a room type that specifies a lake view from the moment you book · the upside is that every room has a private balcony, so even a non-lake-side room can still step out for some air

faq.q: Is there a swimming pool here?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool · the draw here is the lakeside location on Bueng Kaen Nakhon and the artistic atmosphere, not resort-style facilities · but there is exercise space around the lake just across the road — run, walk, or cycle the 3 km loop — and the hotel has bikes to rent · if you want a swimming pool, look at another hotel in Khon Kaen

faq.q: Is getting to Gallery Lake View convenient · should I drive in?
faq.a: The location leans toward the edge of town by the lake, not next to the shopping district or Khao Niao Road · if you are not driving in, hailing a ride at certain times is slower than in the centre, so driving in or renting a car is recommended, and the hotel has roomy free parking · if you rely on Grab or tuk-tuks, have a transport plan ready in advance

faq.q: Who does Gallery Lake View Hotel suit most?
faq.a: It is a great fit for couples and families who drive in, want a lakeside stay on an affordable budget, like a waterside and artistic atmosphere, and love exercising around the lake · it is less suited to people who want a swimming pool, a location next to malls and the central eating-and-drinking strip, or who do not have their own car
